**Jeddah Light** is an [observation tower], port control tower and active [lighthouse] in [Jeddah], [Saudi Arabia]. With a height of 431 ft (131.4 m), it "has a credible claim to be the world's tallest light tower".[[1]] It is located at the end of the outer pier on the north side of the entrance to [Jeddah Seaport].[[2]][[3]]
